scope: Admin catalog Sell flow: custom icon image upload (media-backed) + storefront image render + revert-to-emoji

businessFlow.subject: Admin uploads a custom icon image for a BUILD entry, sees live image preview, the storefront renders the image instead of the emoji, and Revert restores the library emoji

notes: Custom icon upload stores the image in the shared media table (PUBLIC, purpose ICON) and records the media id on sell_entry_config.icon_media_id. The server persists and validates the image (malware scan + WebP conversion); the client never authors the media id or URL. Upload returned 201, revert returned 200; the storefront rendered /api/v1/media/{id} for the uploaded entry and reverted to the emoji glyph after clear. The combobox is now correctly labeled 'Icon' (fixed a nested-label issue from the first pass).
